adjudication_records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:23 — findMembers clamps offset against the cached user_count, which is stale after a removal, so removing the only member on the last page reloads an empty page at an offset equal to the new total instead of stepping back a page (P3, conf 50; `offset = Math.min(this.get("user_count"), Math.max(this.get("offset"), 0));`)

adjudication.rationale: In `Discourse.Group.findMembers`, the request offset is computed as `Math.min(this.get("user_count"), Math.max(this.get("offset"), 0))`. Because `user_count` is only updated *after* the AJAX call (`self.setProperties({ user_count: result.meta.total, ... })`), a removal (`removeMember` → `self.findMembers()`) can leave `user_count` stale while `offset` remains at the previous last-page offset. If the last member on the last page is removed, the new total can drop to exactly the current offset, causing a request with `offset == total` and an empty `members` result, rather than stepping back to the previous page offset. This behavior is directly implied by the diff and is a correctness issue in the new pagination logic.

The public group members route/template were adjusted to read `members` off the group model (`group/members.hbs` iterates `members`, and `group-members` route just calls `model.findMembers()` with no pagination UI), but there are no paging controls/offset updates on the public page, so groups with >50 members will only display the first 50 with no way to access the rest. This is a concrete behavior regression introduced by the diff.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:13 — The new pagination math has no JS test and is off by one: when user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 50 members, limit 50) totalPages is 2, so showingLast is false and "next" loads an empty page at offset 50, which a single QUnit case on currentPage/totalPages would have caught (P2, conf 75; `return Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1;`)

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces pagination computed properties in `admin-group.js.es6`, including `totalPages: Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1`. With `user_count` an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g. 50/50), this yields `2` pages when there is only 1. As a result, `showingLast` is false on page 1 and the `next` action is enabled; `next` sets `offset` to `Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)` (=> 50) and calls `group.findMembers()`, which requests `/groups/:name/members.json?limit=50&offset=50`. Server-side `GroupsController#members` applies `.limit(limit).offset(offset)`, returning an empty `members` array at offset 50, producing a visible empty page. The diff shows no JS tests added that would catch this edge case.
